s:
Eduard Buchner, who was a German chemist, is best known for which of the following?

(I) Winning the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1907

(II) Developing the kinetic theory of enzyme action

(III) Discovering cell-free fermentation
x: Eduard Buchner won the 1907 Nobel Prize in Chemistry 'for his biochemical researches and his discovery of cell-free fermentation' (yeast extract ferments sugar without living cells), so (I) and (III) are right. The kinetic theory of enzyme action (enzyme kinetics) was not his work, so (II) is wrong.

s: She won the crown of Miss World in 1998 :
x: Linor Abargil of Israel won Miss World 1998 in Seychelles; she was crowned by India's Diana Hayden, Miss World 1997. Aishwarya Rai won in 1994, and Wendy Fitzwilliam (Trinidad and Tobago) was Miss Universe 1998, not Miss World.

s: Which Gujarati film won the 70th National Film Award for Best Feature Film promoting national, social and environmental values?
o: More than one of the above
x: At the 70th National Film Awards (films of 2022, announced 16 August 2024, presented 8 October 2024), the Gujarati film Kutch Express (dir. Viral Shah) won Best Feature Film Promoting National, Social and Environmental Values. Hellaro won Best Feature Film at the 66th NFA, and Chhello Show was India's Oscar entry, so 'more than one' is wrong.

s: The Right of Livelihood Award was established in the year
x: The Right Livelihood Award, called the 'Alternative Nobel Prize', was set up in 1980 by Jakob von Uexkull to honour practical solutions to urgent global problems (environment, human rights, peace). 1970, 1990 and 2000 are wrong.

s: Awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2024, Han Kang's novel 'The Vegetarian' won which other prestigious award?
o: More than one of the above
x: Han Kang (South Korea, Nobel Literature 2024) won the 2016 Man Booker International Prize, now the International Booker Prize, with translator Deborah Smith for 'The Vegetarian'. The novel did not win a Pulitzer or a PEN America award, so 'more than one' is wrong.

s: The first Indian to win an Oscar Award was:
x: Bhanu Athaiya became the first Indian to win an Oscar: Best Costume Design for 'Gandhi' at the 1983 Academy Awards (film of 1982). Satyajit Ray got an Honorary Oscar only in 1992, and Mrinal Sen, Bimal Roy and Chetan Anand never won one.

s: Mahmoud Abu Zeid has won the 2018 UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize. He hails from which country?
x: Mahmoud Abu Zeid ('Shawkan'), the 2018 UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize laureate, is an Egyptian photojournalist. He was jailed after covering the 2013 Rabaa sit-in in Cairo and was the first Egyptian to win the prize. He is not from Israel, Iraq or Iran. (The 2026 prize went to the Sudanese Journalists Syndicate.)

s: Who among the following was honored with the 2025 Laureus World Sportsman of the Year award?
x: Swedish pole vaulter Armand 'Mondo' Duplantis was named 2025 Laureus World Sportsman of the Year (Madrid, 21 April 2025), the first field athlete to win it; Simone Biles was Sportswoman. Carlos Alcaraz was a beaten nominee in 2025 and won in 2026; Djokovic was the 2024 winner.
